notes.text: This minor in Artificial Intelligence — using course work from the Thomas Lord Department of Computer Science, the Ming Hsieh Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, and the Daniel J. Epstein Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering — will permit students in STEM disciplines to develop additional skills in the theory and use of artificial intelligence. Advances in machine learning and artificial intelligence have accelerated rapidly; this minor permits students to pursue course work to further develop their knowledge in this area that will be an industry mainstay.
